parameters.name: AppSource
parameters.description:
The type of the SAE application.

- **micro\_service**

- **web**

- **job**

parameters.name: CoType
parameters.description: The type of the change order.

parameters.name: CpuStrategy
parameters.description:
The CPU allocation policy.

- **request**: CPU is allocated only when a request is received.

- **always**: A fixed amount of CPU is always allocated.

parameters.name: CreateTime
parameters.description: The start time when the change order was created.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of entries to return. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the query results. The value of this parameter must be a field in the response parameters.
